dbqueries.dbquery: INSERT INTO tp_requisition_approval_feedback (position_id, from_step_id, to_step_id, by_user_id, to_user_id,feedback_decision, feedback_comment, feedback_date) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,now())
UPDATE tp_requisition_approval_feedback SET from_step_id=?, to_step_id=?, by_user_id=?, to_user_id=?, feedback_decision=?, feedback_comment=?, feedback_date=now() WHERE feedback_id=?

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT traf.feedback_id, traf.position_id, traf.from_step_id, traf.to_step_id,tpos.position_type_ext_int, traf.by_user_id, traf.to_user_id, traf.feedback_decision, traf.feedback_comment, traf.feedback_date , tbi.budget_item_id, tbi.budget_item_name, tpos.position_date_approved FROM tp_positions tpos LEFT JOIN tp_budget_items tbi ON(tbi.budget_item_id = tpos.budget_item_id) , tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf WHERE traf.position_id = tpos.position_id AND tpos.position_status=? AND tpos.position_id=? ORDER BY feedback_id desc LIMIT 0,1 )AS itraf WHERE itraf.to_user_id=? OR(itraf.to_user_id is null AND itraf.by_user_id=? AND itraf.position_date_approved IS NULL)

SELECT traf.feedback_id, traf.position_id, traf.from_step_id, traf.to_step_id, traf.by_user_id, traf.to_user_id, traf.feedback_decision, traf.feedback_comment, traf.feedback_date , tbi.budget_item_name FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf, tp_positions tpos LEFT JOIN tp_budget_items tbi ON(tbi.budget_item_id = tpos.budget_item_id) WHERE traf.feedback_id=? AND tpos.position_id = traf.position_id

SELECT traf.feedback_id, traf.feedback_date, traf.by_user_id, traf.feedback_decision, tras.requisition_approval_step_name, CONCAT(USER_FNAME, ' ', USER_LNAME) as name FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf, tp_requisition_approval_steps tras, tp_users tu WHERE traf.by_user_id = tu.user_id AND traf.from_step_id = tras.requisition_approval_step_id AND traf.position_id=? ORDER BY traf.feedback_id

SELECT traf.feedback_id, traf.position_id, traf.from_step_id, traf.to_step_id, traf.by_user_id, traf.to_user_id, traf.feedback_decision, traf.feedback_comment, traf.feedback_date FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf WHERE traf.position_id=? ORDER BY traf.feedback_id DESC LIMIT 0,1

SELECT tp.requisition_approval_step_id, tpa.user_id FROM tp_requisition_approval_steps tp, tp_requisition_approval_steps_users tpa WHERE tp.requisition_approval_template_id= (SELECT tp.requisition_approval_template_id FROM tp_positions tp WHERE tp.position_id=?) AND tp.requisition_approval_step_id=tpa.requisition_approval_step_id AND tp.requisition_approval_step_rank= (SELECT tpa.requisition_approval_step_rank FROM tp_requisition_approval_steps tpa WHERE tpa.requisition_approval_step_id= (SELECT tp.to_step_id FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback tp WHERE tp.feedback_id= (SELECT max(feedback_id) FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback tpa WHERE tpa.position_id=?)))+1 LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT traf.feedback_id, traf.position_id, traf.from_step_id, traf.to_step_id, traf.by_user_id, traf.to_user_id, traf.feedback_decision, traf.feedback_comment, traf.feedback_date FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf WHERE traf.position_id=? ORDER BY traf.feedback_id ASC LIMIT 0,1

SELECT traf.feedback_id, traf.position_id, traf.from_step_id, traf.to_step_id, traf.by_user_id, traf.to_user_id, traf.feedback_decision, traf.feedback_comment, traf.feedback_date, CONCAT(tu.user_fname, ' ' , tu.user_lname) AS fromUserName, tras.requisition_approval_step_name AS fromStepName, (SELECT CONCAT(tui.user_fname, ' ' , tui.user_lname) FROM tp_users tui WHERE tui.user_id= traf.to_user_id LIMIT 0,1) AS toUserName, (SELECT trasi.requisition_approval_step_name FROM tp_requisition_approval_steps trasi WHERE trasi.requisition_approval_step_id=traf.to_step_id LIMIT 0,1) AS toStepName, tpos.position_title FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf, tp_requisition_approval_steps tras, tp_positions tpos, tp_users tu WHERE traf.position_id=tpos.position_id AND traf.from_step_id = tras.requisition_approval_step_id AND traf.by_user_id = tu.user_id AND traf.feedback_id=?
update tp_positions set position_date_approved=now() where position_id=?

select tps.requisition_approval_step_name from tp_requisition_approval_feedback tpra ,tp_requisition_approval_steps tps where tpra.position_id=? and tpra.to_step_id=? and tps.requisition_approval_step_id=tpra.to_step_id
